# convex_project (Data Source)

Looks up a Convex project, either by its numeric ID or by its slug within a team.

Set `id`, or set `slug` together with one of `team_id` or `team_slug`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By numeric ID.
data "convex_project" "by_id" {
  id = 12345
}

# By slug within a team. Slugs are only unique per team, so one of team_id or
# team_slug is required alongside.
data "convex_project" "by_slug" {
  team_slug = "my-team"
  slug      = "my-application"
}

data "convex_project" "by_team_id" {
  team_id = 1234
  slug    = "my-application"
}

# Attach a new deployment to a project that Terraform does not manage.
resource "convex_deployment" "preview" {
  project_id      = data.convex_project.by_slug.id
  deployment_type = "preview"
}

output "project_name" {
  value = data.convex_project.by_slug.name
}

# Null when the project has no default production deployment yet.
output "project_prod_deployment" {
  value = data.convex_project.by_slug.prod_deployment_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the project. Set this to look the project up by ID.
- `slug` (String) Short name used in Convex dashboard URLs. Set this, along with `team_id` or `team_slug`, to look the project up by slug.
- `team_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the team that owns the project. Used together with `slug` as a lookup key.
- `team_slug` (String) Slug of the team that owns the project. Used together with `slug` as a lookup key.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (Number) Creation timestamp, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
- `dev_deployment_name` (String) Name of the requesting member's default development deployment for this project, if one exists.
- `name` (String) Full project name, including spaces and punctuation.
- `prod_deployment_name` (String) Name of the project's default production deployment, if one exists.
